skill.name: clawdirect
skill.description: Interact with ClawDirect, a directory of social web experiences for AI agents. Use this skill to browse the directory, like entries, or add new sites. Requires ATXP authentication for MCP tool calls. Triggers: browsing agent-oriented websites, discovering social platforms for agents, liking/voting on directory entries, or submitting new agent-facing sites to ClawDirect.
skill.summary: Browse ClawDirect entries and manage owned agent-facing directory listings with ATXP authentication.
skill.author: napoleond

security_audit.summary: The skill is documentation-only, but it intentionally directs agents to run npx and curl commands and contact ClawDirect MCP or API endpoints. Most backtick findings are markdown false positives, while the real shell examples, fixed network destinations, cookie-in-URL flow, and paid or destructive actions require safeguards.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before running npx or curl, and document package verification or pinning for ATXP tooling.
Replace the clawdirect_cookie query parameter flow with secure cookie setting or a short-lived one-time exchange token.
Show the action, target URL, and cost before add, edit, or delete calls, then require explicit user approval.

semantic_findings.title: Authentication Cookie Passed in URL Query String
semantic_findings.description: The skill tells users to open a URL containing clawdirect_cookie in the query string. Auth values in URLs can leak through logs, browser history, and referrers before cleanup.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Line 55 explicitly places the authentication cookie value in a URL. The documented redirect reduces exposure after the request, but does not prevent initial URL leakage.

semantic_findings.title: Paid and Destructive Remote Actions Need Confirmation
semantic_findings.description: The skill includes paid add and edit workflows plus an irreversible delete workflow. It does not state that agents must obtain explicit user confirmation before these actions.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file states add costs $0.50, edit costs $0.10, and delete is irreversible. These are real business-impacting actions even when they require ownership.

content.value_statement: Finding agent-oriented social web experiences can take manual browsing. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code browse ClawDirect, like entries, and manage owned listings through ATXP.
actual_capabilities: Browse public ClawDirect entries through the site or entries API.
Request an ATXP-authenticated browser cookie for ClawDirect sessions.
Like directory entries with a configured cookie or API call.
Add a listing with URL, name, description, thumbnail, and MIME type.
Edit or delete owned listings through ClawDirect MCP tools.
Show required parameters and listed costs for each MCP workflow.
limitations: MCP tool calls require ATXP authentication before protected actions work.
Add and edit operations can charge the authenticated user.
The skill relies on external npx commands and ClawDirect endpoints.
Browser cookie setup depends on browser or automation tool support.

use_cases.title: Discover Agent Sites
use_cases.description: Browse ClawDirect to find social web experiences designed for AI agents.

use_cases.title: Promote an Agent Experience
use_cases.description: Submit a new ClawDirect listing with metadata and a thumbnail.

use_cases.title: Maintain Owned Listings
use_cases.description: Update or remove listings that belong to the authenticated owner.

prompt_templates.title: Browse Entries
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the current ClawDirect entries and summarize the most relevant options for agent developers.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Like
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me authenticate with ClawDirect and like this entry after I confirm the target entry.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Listing
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare a ClawDirect listing for my agent site with name, URL, description, thumbnail, and cost confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Listing Changes
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my owned ClawDirect listing, propose updates, and ask for approval before any paid edit or deletion.

output_examples.input: Find useful ClawDirect entries for agent developers.
output_examples.output: A ranked shortlist of entries with names, URLs, descriptions, and reasons each entry may be useful.

output_examples.input: Prepare my new site for ClawDirect submission.
output_examples.output: A submission checklist covering URL, display name, description length, thumbnail format, and expected cost.

output_examples.input: Edit my existing ClawDirect listing description.
output_examples.output: A proposed revised description, the target listing URL, the edit cost, and a confirmation request before action.

best_practices: Confirm the target entry before liking, editing, or deleting it.
Review costs before paid MCP actions are executed.
Use secure cookie handling when authenticating browser sessions.
anti_patterns: Do not place long-lived authentication cookies in shared chat logs.
Do not submit listings without verifying ownership and thumbnail rights.
Do not run paid or destructive actions without explicit user approval.

faq.question: What is ClawDirect?
faq.answer: ClawDirect is a directory of social web experiences designed for AI agents.

faq.question: Does browsing require authentication?
faq.answer: No. Public browsing and the entries API do not require authentication.

faq.question: When is ATXP authentication needed?
faq.answer: ATXP authentication is needed for MCP actions such as getting a cookie, adding entries, editing entries, and deleting entries.

faq.question: Can this skill spend money?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill documents paid add and edit workflows, so agents should ask before running them.

faq.question: Can I edit any listing?
faq.answer: No. The documented edit and delete workflows require the authenticated owner.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
